svg.title: The threshold claim coexists with the held run
svg.desc: Place the institutional capability assessment beside the still-held run. A reported threshold assessment and a pause are separate facts that coexist. Visual distinction: A bounded workload tray with a large pause pair and a stop bar. A temporary operational disposition, not a breached wall or permanent destruction.
